concerns.text: T016 mandates fetching from 'https://analyse.kmi.open.ac.uk/open_dataset' (FR-001). Plan.md explicitly states the CI runner cannot access this portal and requires using HuggingFace mirrors. Executing T016 violates the plan's environmental constraints and will cause the pipeline to fail, weakening the FR-001 deliverable.

T039 tasks the Reference-Validator Agent with validating 'candidate literature citations'. FR-008 and Plan.md FR-008 explicitly require validating the 'final grade' proxy for 'skill acquisition'. T039 delivers a citation check instead of the required proxy validation, failing to satisfy the FR-008 acceptance criterion.

T032 instructs a sensitivity sweep 'from the onset of the observation period... in 1h steps'. FR-007 requires sweeping the specific *bin boundaries* (2h and 48h) to test stability. T032 implements a data range sweep rather than the required threshold sensitivity analysis, failing to satisfy FR-007.

T037 asserts a hard pass/fail condition that 'flip_rate < 0.05'. FR-007 and SC-003 only require *calculating and reporting* the flip rate as a metric. T037 introduces an arbitrary acceptance threshold not defined in the spec, effectively weakening the requirement from 'measure' to 'pass/fail'.

T009 requires implementing validation against 'contracts/dataset.schema.yaml'. Plan.md Project Structure lists 'contracts/' as a Phase 1 output generated *after* T009. This creates a circular dependency where the task requires a file that does not yet exist, violating the plan's execution order.

T038 requires comparing effect sizes against a '≥0.3 target' and flagging them. SC-001 only requires *reporting* effect sizes and p-values. T038 introduces an arbitrary validation threshold not present in the spec, weakening the requirement from 'report' to 'validate against unlisted target'.
